title: security: rbac v2 - KMS region pinning audit logging enhancements and enforcement toggle
author: Ava Thompson
description: Motivation: tighten audit trail and enforcement controls for RBAC v2 KMS region pinning. The current RBAC v2 allowed region pinning to be set but audit records were inconsistent when requests were routed to fallback KMS keys; ops lacked a clear signal when region constraints were overridden. This PR: (1) standardizes audit events for all KMS selection paths (preferred, fallback, and denied) and includes metadata for policy id, rule hit, and resolved region; (2) adds an API- and config-driven enforcement toggle (rbac.v2.kms_enforce_region_pinning) allowing rollout as audit-only -> enforce; (3) surfaces enforcement decisions in the admin console metrics and per-request trace headers; (4) hardens RBAC evaluation to short-circuit on explicit deny and emits deterministic audit.reason codes for downstream processors. Implementation notes: added audit hook in pkg/rbac/v2/evaluator.go that generates structured audit events (event_type, policy_id, rule_id, decision, resolved_kms_key, resolved_region, reason_code) and plumbing to the audit-log service via internal/auditclient; introduced config flag with feature gating and migration helper in infra/config/defaults.go; updated docs and console annotations in redwood-console to display pins and decisions; added unit and integration tests and an end-to-end canary against staging KMS. Checklist: - [x] design doc and Linear tickets (ENG-3421, SEC-1146) referenced; - [x] unit tests added; - [x] integration test added with simulated KMS fallback; - [x] console UI annotation added; - [x] rolling deploy strategy documented; - [x] GA rollout plan: enable audit-only by default for 48h, monitor alerts, flip to enforce if no regressions. Risks and mitigations: risk of false-enforcement for older service accounts — mitigated by audit-only default and ability to whitelist service-account tags in rbac policies; risk of audit event volume spike — added cardinality controls and sample_rate config in auditclient. CI: initial run had a flakey integration test (kms-emulator startup timeouts), fixed by adding retry/backoff in tests; final CI is green. Merge: squash-merged to main after approvals and successful canary on staging. Rollout notes: set rbac.v2.kms_enforce_region_pinning=false in global config for first 48h post-merge to collect audit events, monitor metric rbac.kms_region_pinning.overrides and rbac.kms_region_pinning.denies, then evaluate for enforcement.

review_comments: Ethan Chen: Please ensure the audit event schema includes a stable reason_code enum so downstream processors don't rely on freeform strings. Also add a small migration note for historical events.
Ava Thompson: Good call; added reason_code enum and migration note in docs. Kept a freeform description for human readability but reason_code is the primary signal.
Monique Alvarez: We saw high cardinality in a previous audit change — did you add limits or sampling?
Ava Thompson: Yes, added sample_rate and max_unique_values in internal/auditclient; defaults are conservative. Included config guidance in the runbook.
Omar Rahman: Integration test flaky on first CI run due to emulator startup. Can you add retry/backoff?
Ava Thompson: Added exponential backoff and health-check loop; reran CI and green. Marking resolved.
Ethan Chen: Approved after minor nits addressed (schema comments and console keyboard accessibility).
release_notes: Enhancement: RBAC v2 KMS region pinning now emits standardized audit events for preferred/fallback/deny decisions and introduces a feature-flag (rbac.v2.kms_enforce_region_pinning) to toggle enforcement. Admin console surfaces decisions and resolved KMS keys. Rollout will start audit-only mode for 48h before enforcement.
notes_for_ops: After merge: ensure rbac.v2.kms_enforce_region_pinning=false in global config; monitor metrics rbac.kms_region_pinning.overrides and rbac.kms_region_pinning.denies and the audit stream for reason_code=OVERRIDDEN or DENIED. If low false positives after 48h, flip to true and watch for increased error rates on KMS calls.
canary_test_summary: Canary against staging with 5k synthetic requests across regions; observed 112 override events and 3 denies (expected). Latency impact negligible (<1ms p50 increase). No user-facing errors in staging during audit-only window.
security_review: Security reviewed by SEC team (SEC-1146). No sensitive data added to audit payloads; only key IDs and region strings are emitted. KMS key IDs are hashed in production audit stream by default (configurable).
notes: Backported follow-up ticket created (ENG-3499) to add webhook enrichment for SIEM ingestion.
